text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated reserved pool 'resv-us-west-2-42' at 100% GPU utilization for 6m. Queue depth increasing, throttles observed. Severity: P1. Paging oncall_jess.

oncall_jess: seeing the bot. joining. what's the impact? any customer-facing errors? :eyes:

sre_mike: Grafana shows sustained queue growth on resv-us-west-2-42 starting ~3187654200. avg wait time -> 18s, 95p token latency spiking. Autoscaler attempted a scale at 3187654280 but rate-limited by quota.

eng_runtime_lee: confirming autoscaler logs: ``ERROR: scale_request_rejected: quota_exceeded (gpu_pool_quota)``. Also a spike of long-running sessions from tenant 'HelixCorp' (reserved) + noisy shared sessions from 'dev-internal' pinned to the pool.

product_sam: CS reported degraded endpoint for HelixCorp, 429s and timeouts on long prompts. Can we triage fast?

cs_anna: HelixCorp on a support call. They see streaming stalls and partial responses. They're escalating to their platform ops. CS shared correlation logs (trace ids) in the bridge.

oncall_jess: immediate mitigations? Can we evict non-reserved sessions or shift noisy tenant?

eng_runtime_lee: plan: 1) throttle non-reserved tenant 'dev-internal' by applying session-level RBAC @ 3187654300 2) attempt fallback routing of HelixCorp to resv-us-west-2-43 (same region) if capacity free 3) request emergency quota bump to cloud infra (ticket opened).

sre_mike: executing step 1 now: /run apply-tenant-throttle --tenant dev-internal --max-sessions 2 --reason "noisy neighbor"

sre_mike: (bot) deploy-bot: Started job deploy/tenant-throttle/3187654312

sre_mike: throttle applied, sessions dropped from 18 -> 2, CPU/GPU usage dropped ~12% within 35s. Queue depth reduced slightly.

eng_runtime_lee: attempting route switch for HelixCorp: checking model compatibility and kernel variants. If we reroute to resv-us-west-2-43 need to ensure model variant xq-2 matches.

oncall_jess: is resv-us-west-2-43 free? can we do a temporary pin?

eng_runtime_lee: resv-us-west-2-43 has 40% headroom. I can kick off a live routing policy: /run route-policy add --tenant HelixCorp --from resv-us-west-2-42 --to resv-us-west-2-43 --mode gradual --max-traffic 30%

eng_runtime_lee: (note) model variant mismatch for longer contexts, so we only divert short prompt traffic initially.

prod_sam: acknowledgement: inform HelixCorp about planned partial reroute and ETA ~5m for initial reduction. cs_anna please update the call.

cs_anna: pinging HelixCorp: "We are applying a mitigation that will route some of your short requests to an alternate reserved capacity to reduce stalls. We'll update in 10m."

acct_raj: will this impact billing or SLA? Need to notify finance if fallback uses different metering.

eng_runtime_lee: fallback routing keeps reserved reservation tags so billing stays on HelixCorp reserved pool. No cross-tenant billing expected for this policy.

incident-bot: NOTE: Autoscaler attempted 3 retries; last_response: 429 cloud-quota. Ticket https://cloud.example/tickets/CRQ-8921 created for quota increase.

oncall_jess: cloud quota ticket up — who owns cloud-side escalation?

acct_raj: I'm on it, pinged cloud sales and filed urgent quota bump. ETA from cloud support ~20m but asked for expedited.

eng_runtime_lee: additional mitigation: enable aggressive KV prefix caching for HelixCorp's common prompts to reduce token compute. /run enable-prefix-cache --tenant HelixCorp --ttl 600 --max-entries 5000

eng_runtime_lee: prefix cache enabled at 3187654360. initial hit-rate ~2% (warming), should improve.

sre_mike: monitoring metrics: queue depth down 45% after throttle + partial reroute + caching. token latency 95p down from 14s -> 6s.

cs_anna: HelixCorp confirms partial improvement on the call; still seeing occasional stalls on long streaming sessions. They're appreciative of fast action.

oncall_jess: what's the status of noisy tenant hard limit? Could we temporarily evict remaining non-reserved sessions if they keep causing pressure? Need to avoid data loss for customers though.

eng_runtime_lee: eviction policy is last-resort. We can set aggressive preempt policy for the pool for non-reserved sessions: /run preempt --pool resv-us-west-2-42 --target-tenants non_reserved --min-runtime 30s --grace-period 60s

acct_raj: please confirm we notify affected dev-internal users. Preemption will drop sessions. I want a CI/backup flag set.

eng_runtime_lee: adding notices to dev-internal channel and applying grace period. preempt job started at 3187654385.

deploy-bot: Job preempt/3187654385: started.

eng_runtime_lee: preemption evicted 10 sessions (non-reserved), freed ~18% of GPUs. Pool now at 72% utilization.

sre_mike: great, overall utilization stable around 68-75%. No further throttles. Queue depth normalizing.

product_sam: customer impact: HelixCorp had degraded streaming and partial timeouts for ~12m window. We need incident summary and postmortem. Assign owners?

oncall_jess: owners: eng_runtime_lee (mitigation + routing), sre_mike (monitoring + metrics), acct_raj (cloud quota escalation), cs_anna (customer comms), product_sam (postmortem + severity assessment).

cs_anna: logged customer timeline and will share with product and HelixCorp.

acct_raj: cloud support replied: temporary quota uplift granted for 2 hours starting 3187654500. Need to verify autoscaler will reattempt.

eng_runtime_lee: set autoscaler backoff reset and scheduled retry at 3187654490. Will monitor retries.

sre_mike: final checks: no errors in model runtime, no kernel OOMs. Root cause appears to be combination of quota-limited autoscaler + noisy non-reserved sessions pinned to reserved pool.

product_sam: postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (quota + noisy neighbor), mitigation (throttle, reroute, prefix cache, preempt), action items (quota increase automation, per-tenant isolation rules, autoscaler resilience).

oncall_jess: closing the live page: we'll keep monitoring for 1h. If metrics stable at 15m checks, mark incident resolved.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity downgraded to P2 at 3187654415. Next automated check at 3187655015.

eng_runtime_lee: note for follow-up: consider reserve-autoscaler policy: do not place non-reserved sessions into reserved pools by default. Also implement faster eviction path for noisy internal tenants.

cs_anna: HelixCorp requests a post-incident call tomorrow; scheduled.

oncall_jess: thanks team. Good job triaging quickly. :clap::heart:

acct_raj: I'll confirm billing neutrality and cloud quota longer-term.

product_sam: assigning postmortem drafts to me, will loop in eng and sre.

sre_mike: logging metrics snapshot and saving dashboards to incident runbook.
